verification.transport_scope: Explicit fixture supplier/marketplace read transports; not live API capability evidence
verification.hard_rejection_two_cycles: Candidate counts 1 then 0; detail refreshed once; pages 1 then 2; second cycle skipped_rejections=1 and exactly one business read; both engine SyncLogs success, new eligible count zero
verification.pending_external_evidence: Revisited on both identical cycles; new eligible counts 1 then 0; hold_pending_external_evidence; not blacklisted or publish-ready
verification.policy: Profit and margin changes invalidate cooldown; unrelated candidate limit retains cooldown; other concepts remain reconsiderable
verification.ttl: 24 hours; just before expiry retained; exact expiry and future observations not retained
verification.finite_budget: Engine requested limit 50 with 10 configured niches: capped to 12 candidates, 6 searches, 12 detail evaluations, 24 product.get attempts including fact enrichment; total read attempts <=102 in fixture; no unbounded loop
verification.existing_regressions: Five-page cursor wrap, 512-entry/524288-byte history, atomic save, corrupt JSON/oversize reset, snapshot scope, semantic relevance, niche allocation and preparation regressions passed

parent_final_integration: Run the full external regression suite once after all disjoint source writers freeze; the earlier 371-test baseline does not certify this changed revision
Verify deployed/running worker source revision separately if claiming deployment completion
external_evidence: No new live supplier/marketplace capability or live two-cycle result claimed by this review; previous live artifacts belong to their recorded older revision
